units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. The materials, reports and applications specified in parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article shall be considered by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. An administrative offence case may be initiated by an official authorised to draw up administrative offence records only where there is at least one of the reasons provided for by parts 1, 1.1 and 1.3 of this Article and sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred, except in the cases provided for by part 3.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.1. A case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements whose observance is assessed as part of state control (supervision) or municipal control, where one of the reasons for initiating a case provided for by points 1 - 3 of part 1 of this Article exists, may be initiated only after conducting a control (supervisory) measure involving interaction with the controlled person, an inspection, or a control (supervisory) action within permanent state control (supervision) or a permanent inspection patrol, and documenting their results, except in the cases provided for by parts 3.2 - 3.9 of this Article and Article 28.6 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.2. An administrative offence case may be initiated before documenting the results of a control (supervisory) measure, inspection or control (supervisory) action within permanent state control (supervision) or a permanent inspection patrol where it is necessary to apply measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case provided for by Articles 27.10, 27.14 and 27.16 of this Code. In all cases where administrative offence cases are initiated before documenting the results of a control (supervisory) measure, inspection or control (supervisory) action within permanent state control (supervision) or a permanent inspection patrol, the official who drew up the record of application of a measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case shall notify the prosecutor within twenty-four hours.
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.3. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 9.21 of this Code may be initiated by the federal antimonopoly authority or its territorial body without conducting control (supervisory) measures if the materials, reports or applications received by the federal antimonopoly authority or its territorial body contain sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
units.label: Part 3.3 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.4. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 9.1 of this Code may be initiated without conducting control (supervisory) measures where information on the organisation of in-house control over compliance with industrial safety requirements has not been submitted to the executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the sphere of industrial safety.
units.label: Part 3.4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.5. Without conducting control (supervisory) measures involving interaction with the controlled person, the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications may initiate cases concerning administrative offences:
units.label: Part 3.5 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) provided for by parts 1 - 2.1, 4 and 10 - 18 of Article 13.11 (where data confirming that an administrative offence has occurred are received from the individual or legal entity that committed the administrative offence), parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 13.11.3 (where data confirming that an administrative offence has occurred are received from the legal entity that committed the administrative offence), part 1 of Article 13.21 (where data confirming the production or distribution of products of a mass media outlet whose registration entry has not been amended to reflect a change of founder or a change in the composition of co-founders are received from the mass media outlet that committed the administrative offence) of this Code, and also in the cases provided for by Article 6.13 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), part 2 of Article 6.21.1 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), part 2 of Article 6.21.2 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), Articles 13.2.1 and 13.4, parts 3, 5 and 5.1 of Article 13.11, Article 13.11.2, parts 2 - 11 of Article 13.15 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), Article 13.15.1 (as regards late provision by the editorial office of a mass media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher of information on the receipt of funds, the provision of which is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media), part 1 of Article 13.21 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets, except for the production or distribution of products of a mass media outlet whose registration entry has not been amended to reflect a change of founder or a change in the composition of co-founders), parts 2, 2.1 and 3 of Article 13.21 (as regards administrative offences committed using mass media), Article 13.22, parts 1 - 3, 5 and 6 of Article 13.29, Article 13.29.4, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 13.31, Articles 13.34 and 13.40, Article 13.42 (in cases of violation of the procedure for operating, in a communications operator’s communications network, technical means for countering threats to the stability, security and integrity of the functioning in the territory of the Russian Federation of the Internet information and telecommunications network and the public communications network, and violation of legislative requirements for the operation of technical means for monitoring compliance with legislative requirements providing for restriction of access to information), Articles 13.42.1, 13.43.1 and 13.44, parts 1 and 3 of Article 13.45, parts 1 and 5 of Article 13.54, parts 2, 3 and 5 of Article 14.3.1, and parts 6 and 7 of Article 19.7.10 of this Code;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.5 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) provided for by part 6 of Article 13.11, Article 13.15.1 (as regards failure by the editorial office of a mass media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher to provide information on the receipt of funds, the provision of which is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media), part 1 of Article 13.21 (as regards the production or distribution of products of unregistered mass media outlets), part 4 of Article 13.29, parts 2 - 4 of Article 13.31, Article 13.38, and part 4 of Article 14.1 (as regards a gross violation of licensing requirements consisting in failure by a communications operator to comply with requirements for communications networks and facilities for conducting operational-search activities) of this Code, in the case provided for by point 2 of part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.5 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.6. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.5.1, 8.41 and 8.41.1 of this Code may be initiated without conducting control (supervisory) measures where materials held by or received by the body exercising state environmental supervision contain sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
units.label: Part 3.6 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.7. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 11.16, parts 2, 3 and 4 of Article 14.1, and Articles 19.20 and 20.4 of this Code may be initiated by the body exercising federal state fire supervision without conducting control (supervisory) measures where materials, reports or applications, including those concerning fire-related crimes and incidents, held by or received by the body exercising federal state fire supervision contain sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
units.label: Part 3.7 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.8. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 14.1 and parts 2 and 3 of Article 19.20 of this Code may be initiated without conducting control (supervisory) measures in relation to licensees engaged in the installation, maintenance and repair of fire safety equipment for buildings and structures where sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred have been established as a result of control (supervisory) measures conducted within federal state fire supervision.
units.label: Part 3.8 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.9. A case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with any of the mandatory requirements specified in the second paragraph of this part may be initiated by an official authorised to draw up records of such administrative offences upon discovery of sufficient data indicating that the relevant administrative offence has occurred, where such data were obtained during a control (supervisory) measure without interaction with the controlled person or during implementation of a special regime of state control (supervision) — monitoring, in the course of which, during the experiment provided for by Article 14 of Law of the Russian Federation of 15 April 1993 No. 4802-I ‘On the Status of the Capital of the Russian Federation’, technical and/or software tools with functions for photography and motion-picture recording, audio and video recording, detection, recognition, analysis and identification of objects, measurement of quantitative and qualitative indicators, including weighing, as well as state information systems were used.
units.label: Part 3.9 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: In accordance with the first paragraph of this part, an administrative offence case may be initiated in the federal city of Moscow in the event of non-compliance with any mandatory requirement whose observance is assessed as part of regional state control (supervision) over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage sites, regional state construction supervision, regional state environmental control (supervision), regional state geological control (supervision), regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of protection and use of specially protected natural areas, regional state control (supervision) over road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure, regional state housing control (supervision), regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of protection and rational use of urban soils, regional state control (supervision) over compliance with requirements for the protection of green plantings, municipal control over road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure, municipal land control, or municipal control in the sphere of territorial improvement.
units.label: Part 3.9 Art. 28.1 · “In accordance with the first paragraph of this part, an…”

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. An administrative offence case is deemed initiated from the moment of:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) drawing up a record of inspection of the place where the administrative offence was committed;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) drawing up the first record of application of measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case provided for by Article 27.1 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) drawing up an administrative offence record or issuance by a prosecutor of a ruling initiating an administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) issuing a procedural order initiating an administrative offence case where an administrative investigation provided for by Article 28.7 of this Code is necessary;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) repealed. — Federal Law of 09.11.2009 No. 249-ФЗ;
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case in the case provided for by part 1, 3 or 4 of Article 28.6 of this Code;
units.label: Point 6 Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) issuing a procedural order requesting information in accordance with part 5 of Article 26.10 of this Code in the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code.
units.label: Point 7 Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. Where initiation of an administrative offence case is refused despite the existence of materials, reports or applications specified in points 2 and 3 of part 1 of this Article, the official who considered those materials, reports or applications shall issue a reasoned procedural order refusing to initiate an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: Note. The provisions of parts 3.1 and 3.2 of this Article apply to the initiation of cases concerning administrative offences consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements whose observance is assessed as part of state control (supervision) or municipal control, the organisation and implementation of which are governed by Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 248-ФЗ ‘On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation’ or Federal Law of 26 December 2008 No. 294-ФЗ ‘On the Protection of the Rights of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs in the Exercise of State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control’.
units.label: Art. 28.1 · “Note. The provisions of parts 3.1 and 3.2 of this Article apply…”

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.label: Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.label: Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 1. Where an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 or part 2 of Article 12.30 of this Code is committed, a record of inspection of the place where the administrative offence was committed shall be drawn up.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 2. A record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be drawn up immediately after the commission of the administrative offence is detected.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 3. Inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be conducted by persons authorised to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with part 1 of Article 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 4. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew up the record, particulars of the person who was directly driving the vehicle at the time the administrative offence was committed, the vehicle’s type, make, model and state registration plate, and the surnames, first names, patronymics and residential addresses of attesting witnesses (if participating), witnesses and victims, where there are witnesses and victims, the place and time of commission and the occurrence of the administrative offence, the Article of this Code providing for administrative liability for that administrative offence, and other information necessary to resolve the case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 5. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall describe:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 1) the actions of the officials specified in part 3 of Article 28.1.1 of this Code, in the order in which they were performed;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 2) the condition and quality of the road surface, the presence or absence of road markings, and the degree of illumination of the section of road where the administrative offence was committed;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 3) the type of intersection (controlled or uncontrolled) where the administrative offence was committed, whether the traffic lights were functioning or defective, and the presence or absence of priority signs;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 4) other circumstances material to the case.
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 6. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall also set out statements made by persons who participated in the inspection.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 7. When drawing up a record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed, persons participating in the inspection shall have their rights and duties under this Code explained to them, and an entry to that effect shall be made in the record.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 8. An entry shall be made in the record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed concerning the use of photography and motion-picture recording and other established methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during the inspection using photography and motion-picture recording or other established methods of recording physical evidence shall be attached to the relevant record.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
units.text: 9. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be signed by the official who drew it up and by the persons who participated in the inspection. Copies of the record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be handed to the persons who were directly driving the vehicles at the time the administrative offence was committed.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 28.1.1

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.label: Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.label: Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 1. A record shall be drawn up concerning the commission of an administrative offence, except in the cases provided for by Article 28.4 and parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 28.6 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 1.1. Where, for objective reasons, the individual against whom a case concerning such an offence is being initiated, that individual’s legal representative, or the legal representative of a legal entity against which an administrative offence case is being initiated cannot be present when the administrative offence record is drawn up, their presence may be ensured through videoconferencing systems if the body or official has the technical capability, or through a web-conferencing system if the body, official, that individual, the individual’s legal representative or the legal representative of that legal entity has the technical capability.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: The question of ensuring the presence of the persons specified in the first paragraph of this part when an administrative offence record is drawn up through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system shall be decided by the official authorised to draw up the administrative offence record, at the request of those persons or on the official’s own initiative.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 28.2 · “The question of ensuring the presence of the persons specified…”

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: The official authorised to draw up an administrative offence record shall notify the persons specified in the first paragraph of this part of the date, time and place of the videoconference arrangements or the date and time of the web conference no later than ten working days before the day on which the administrative offence record is to be drawn up.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 28.2 · “The official authorised to draw up an administrative offence…”

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 1.2. Where videoconferencing systems are used when drawing up an administrative offence record, the official authorised to draw it up shall establish a connection with a structural subdivision of the body, a territorial body or a structural subdivision of a territorial body in which videoconferencing systems are used, to ensure the presence of the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article when the record is drawn up. The person arranging the videoconference shall assist the official authorised to draw up the administrative offence record in checking attendance and establishing the identity of the persons appearing.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 1.3. The identity of the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article, when an administrative offence record is drawn up through a web-conferencing system, shall be established using information technology tools enabling identification of a person without their physical presence (the unified identification and authentication system and the unified biometric system).
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 1.4. Where an individual against whom an administrative offence case is being initiated, that individual’s legal representative, or the legal representative of a legal entity against which an administrative offence case is being initiated is present when the administrative offence record is drawn up through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system, the record shall be drawn up no later than the working day following the day on which the videoconference was arranged or the web conference was held.
units.label: Part 1.4 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 2. An administrative offence record shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew up the record, particulars of the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, the surnames, first names, patronymics and residential addresses of witnesses and victims, where there are witnesses and victims, the place and time of commission and the occurrence of the administrative offence, the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for that administrative offence, the explanation of the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the case has been initiated, and other information necessary to resolve the case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 3. When an administrative offence record is drawn up, the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, and other participants in the proceedings, shall have their rights and duties under this Code explained to them, and an entry to that effect shall be made in the record.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 4. The individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated shall be given the opportunity to inspect the administrative offence record, or, where they are present when the administrative offence record is drawn up through videoconferencing systems, a copy of that record sent in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 5.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: The persons specified in the first paragraph of this part may submit explanations and comments concerning the contents of the record, which shall be attached to the record.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.2 · “The persons specified in the first paragraph of this part may…”

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 4.1. Where the individual, the individual’s legal representative, or the legal representative of the legal entity against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are being conducted fails to appear, provided that they have been duly notified, the administrative offence record shall be drawn up in their absence. A copy of the administrative offence record shall be sent to the person in respect of whom it was drawn up within three days from the day it was drawn up.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 5. The administrative offence record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and by the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, except in the cases provided for by part 5.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: Where persons refuse to sign the record (a copy of the record), and in the case provided for by part 4.1 of this Article, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.2 · “Where persons refuse to sign the record (a copy of the record),…”

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 5.1. Where an administrative offence record is drawn up using videoconferencing systems, the record shall be signed on paper by the official who drew it up, after which that official shall send a copy of the record to the structural subdivision of the body, territorial body or structural subdivision of the territorial body where the videoconference is arranged, for that copy to be signed by the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: In addition to their handwritten signatures, the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article shall mark their receipt on the paper copy of the record.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 28.2 · “In addition to their handwritten signatures, the persons…”

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: The copy of the record signed by the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article and bearing their acknowledgement of receipt of that copy shall be sent by the person arranging the videoconference to the official who drew up the administrative offence record immediately, but no later than the end of the working day.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 28.2 · “The copy of the record signed by the persons specified in the…”

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: Where the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article refuse to sign the copy of the record, the person arranging the videoconference shall make a corresponding entry on that copy and send it to the official who drew up the administrative offence record within the period provided for by the third paragraph of this part.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 28.2 · “Where the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1…”

units.locator: Article 28.2. Administrative offence record
units.text: 6. A copy of the administrative offence record shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, and to the victim, except where those persons are present when the record is drawn up using a web-conferencing system.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28.2

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.label: Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.label: Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 1. Records of administrative offences provided for by this Code shall be drawn up by officials of bodies authorised to consider administrative offence cases in accordance with Chapter 23 of this Code, within the competence of the relevant body.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 2. In addition to the cases provided for by part 1 of this Article, administrative offence records may be drawn up by the officials specified in this Article of federal executive authorities and their structural subdivisions and territorial bodies, officials of other state bodies in accordance with the tasks and functions assigned to them by federal laws or regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, and officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation where the exercise of powers of the Russian Federation in state control and supervision has been transferred to them on the basis of federal laws, regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation on transferring powers of federal executive authorities for exercise by executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, adopted in accordance with federal laws, or agreements concluded in accordance with federal law between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on transferring the exercise of part of their powers:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.3
